body.name: \mathcal I_n
body.construction: \(\mathcal I_n=\{C:C(O^{(n)},m_0,m_1,p,r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\subseteq\mathbb R\text{ is an interval and }O^{(n)}\mapsto C(O^{(n)},m_0,m_1,p,r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\text{ is measurable for every supplied }(m_0,m_1,p)\text{ and every }(r_{0n},r_{1n},r_{en})\in[0,\bar r]^3\}\).
